entities.summary: Aauri Lorena Bokesa Abia is a Spanish sprinter who specializes in the 400 metres. She represented Spain at the 2012 Summer Olympics where she was 6th in Round 1 with a time of 53.67. At the 2016 Olympics, she was 6th again in her first round heat, in a time of 53.51. Bokesa also plays basketball for the women's counterpart of CB Estudiantes.
